title: tau version --json output
description: Schema for the single JSON object `tau version --json` (and `tau version --verbose|--check` under --mode json) prints on stdout. "name" and "version" are always present. --verbose adds the build fields (commit, target, build_date, zig); --check adds the update-check fields (checked, latest, update_available, and conditionally tag/update_url/reason). New keys may be added (additive); existing keys keep their names and types.

commit.description: Short git hash of HEAD at build time ("unknown" for tarball builds; "-dirty" marks a worktree with uncommitted changes). Emitted with --verbose.

target.description: arch-os-abi target triple, e.g. "x86_64-linux-gnu". Emitted with --verbose.

build_date.description: UTC build stamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH-aware). Emitted with --verbose.

zig.description: Zig compiler version that built the binary. Emitted with --verbose.

checked.description: Whether the update lookup actually ran — false when offline, curl is missing, or TAU_NO_UPDATE_CHECK is set. Emitted with --check.

latest.description: Latest released version string when the check ran and found a release; null otherwise. Emitted with --check.

tag.description: Raw release tag (e.g. "v0.4.0") when the registry reported one. Emitted with --check.

update_available.description: true when the latest release is newer than the running binary. Emitted with --check.

update_url.description: Release page URL for the newer version; present only when update_available is true.

reason.description: Why the check did not run or did not find a release (e.g. "disabled (TAU_NO_UPDATE_CHECK)"); informational, may be reworded.
